text.prefix: The effective policy [p.8] for a UDDI endpoint includes the element policy [p.9] of the uddi:bindingTemplate element that defines the endpoint merged [p.8] with the element policy [p.9] of those uddi:tModel elements that are referenced in contained uddi:tModelInstanceInfo elements.

The effective policy [p.9] for a UDDI endpoint includes the element policy [p.9] of the uddi:bindingTemplate element that defines the endpoint merged [p.9] with the element policy [p.9] of those uddi:tModel elements that are referenced in contained uddi:tModelInstanceInfo elements.
